policy: minimal, case-targeted (METHODOLOGY §6). The real ZooKeeper source and the real DEBUG reproduction log are kept; package names, class names (ZooKeeperMain, ZooKeeper, ClientCnxn, KeeperException), the Stat data class, znode/session/quorum vocabulary and the whole server-side log are untouched. Only the identifiers that pin the specific JIRA case are renamed.

bug_id_scrub.note: Neither the reporting ticket nor the trunk ticket that carries the fix may appear in any LLM-facing artifact. The scratch clone path (repos/Zookeeper-Zookeeper-1434) and reproduce.sh's temp dir were therefore moved to neutral paths (repos/zookeeper-anonymized, /tmp/zk-repro-XXXX) before the log-producing run, because the JVM prints java.class.path and user.dir into the log.

renames.where: ZooKeeperMain.java: commandMap.put("stat","path [watch]") and the dispatch branch cmd.equals("stat"); consequently every occurrence in the reproduction log (the shell prompt lines and the production DEBUG line 'Processing stat')
renames.why: This is the term that names the case — the ticket is literally 'stat command on non-existing node causes NPE'. Renaming it stops the LLM from string-matching the ticket or the reported session transcript.

renames.kind: private static method of ZooKeeperMain (all 6 occurrences: declaration + 5 call sites)
renames.where: ZooKeeperMain.java; consequently the top frame of the uncaught-exception trace in the log
renames.why: The JIRA report quotes the stack trace verbatim, whose distinctive token is 'ZooKeeperMain.printStat'. Renaming it means the trace this build emits no longer matches the reported one.

jira_quoted_text_redaction.what_the_ticket_quotes: a 6-frame NullPointerException stack trace (printStat <- processZKCmd <- processCmd <- executeLine <- run <- main, ZooKeeperMain.java lines 130/722/581/353/311/270 in 3.3.5)
jira_quoted_text_redaction.how_handled: Not blanked out (the trace IS the symptom). It is de-matched by the renames above plus the fact that this tree is 3.4.0-dev: the log's trace reads printNodeMeta/132, processZKCmd/727, processCmd/583, executeLine/355, run/313, main/272. The remaining frame names (processZKCmd, processCmd, executeLine, run, main) are generic dispatch methods of the kept-real class and are not case-identifying.
jira_quoted_text_redaction.note: No other log or stack-trace text is quoted or attached in the ticket, so nothing else in the reproduction log needed redaction.

regeneration.how: copies the pre-fix working tree (with private/deps-fix.patch already applied) to the neutral path repos/zookeeper-anonymized, applies the two renames to ZooKeeperMain.java, rebuilds with `ant jar`, re-runs reproduce.sh (STAT_CMD=meta, PORT=21812) against the RENAMED build, publishes private/symptom.orig.log as logs/symptom.log, copies the curated failure-path files into source/, and re-verifies zero leakage.
regeneration.note: The symptom log is never rewritten after the fact — it is the genuine output of the renamed binary.
